questions.prompt: The general defended himself bravely against the enemy.

questions.answer: Philosophus, suī memor, omne perīculum vītāvit.

questions.answer: Philosophī sē tōtōs studiō sapientiae dēdidērunt.

questions.answer: Tyrannus, potentiae cupidus, suī neglegēns erat.

questions.answer: Sua quemque ambitiō ad glōriam impellit.

questions.answer: Fortūna prō suīs quemque meritīs fovet.

questions.answer: Mē tōtum studiō litterārum trādidī.

questions.answer: Sē sōlum amāre superbī animī est.
